Description: Phosphorus and potassium fertiliser, spread over the whole field and harrowed in before sowing. No nitrogen was given, as the crop fixes its own.
Dosage: 300 kg phosphorus and 150 kg potassium per hectare

Description: Pre-emergence herbicide against annual broad-leaved weeds: pendimethalin, sprayed over the whole field after sowing.
Dosage: 1.3 litres of a 10 percent solution per hectare
Comments: The eastern half of the field was sprayed a day later, on 2025-04-11, because of wind.
